name: soia-dev
description: 工程与 UI 技能：功能规格、架构、实现审查、UI 设计验收与按需工具

displayDescription.en: Implements scoped changes and fixes with real verification, plus on-demand read-only review, clear views, architecture, feature specs and UI methods.
displayDescription.zh: 按明确范围实现需求与修复缺陷，验证真实结果；按需只读审查、展示关系，并提供架构与功能规格方法。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Implement this task within its scope and verify the actual result.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 按明确范围完成这个任务，并验证真实结果。

quickPrompts.en: Implement this task within its scope and verify the actual result.
quickPrompts.zh: 按明确范围完成这个任务，并验证真实结果。

quickPrompts.en: Review this diff once, read-only, and report evidence-backed issues.
quickPrompts.zh: 对这个 diff 做一次只读审查，报告有证据的问题。

quickPrompts.en: Turn this requirement into a feature spec with acceptance slices.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这个需求写成功能规格和可验收切片。
